item.title: Haystack Launches Central Index for Community Integrations
item.description:
Haystack Launches Central Index for Community Integrations

A new repository provides an index of Haystack integrations that can be used with a Haystack Pipeline or Agent.

📂 Overview

This repository lists integrations that are maintained by their respective owners or authors and can be browsed on the Haystack Integrations page.

🛠️ Types of Integrations

  • Document Store
  • Model Provider
  • Data Ingestion
  • Monitoring Tool
  • Evaluation Framework
  • Custom Component
  • Tool Integration
  • Something new!

📄 Contribution Guide

  • Create a pull request adding a .md file to the integrations/ directory.
  • Start with the draft integration page: https://github.com/deepset-ai/haystack-integrations/blob/main/draft-integration.md
  • Include required frontmatter fields (see table).
  • Ensure at least one of pypi or repo fields is present.
  • After merging, the integration will appear on the integrations page.

🗂️ Frontmatter Fields

Field Requirement
layout required
name required
description required
authors required (name of each author)
type required
toc optional
logo optional
version required (Haystack 2.0)
pypi optional (must include if no repo)
repo optional (must include if no pypi)
report_issue optional

🚀 Availability

Browse all integrations on the Haystack Integrations page (https://haystack.deepset.ai/integrations) to see author information, installation instructions, and usage details.

#Haystack #Integrations #OpenSource #MachineLearning

Source: deepset-ai/haystack-integrations

item.title: New MCP Servers Extend AI Capabilities
item.description:
New MCP Servers Extend AI Capabilities

A collection of MCP servers has been introduced, extending AI capabilities through various integrations.

🔍 Overview

  • MCP is an open protocol enabling AI models to interact with local and remote resources.
  • This list focuses on production-ready and experimental MCP servers.
  • Servers extend AI capabilities through file access, database connections, API integrations, and other contextual services.

🧩 How it works

  • MCP servers allow AI models to securely interact with resources.
  • Servers can be installed and run from GitHub repositories.
  • A web-based directory is available, synced with the repository.

⚙️ Key details

  • Servers for accessing many apps and tools through a single MCP server.
  • Automatically fetches the latest arXiv papers on VLN, VLA, SLAM, 3D, and Embodied AI.
  • Each section in the README corresponds to a search keyword.
  • The full list of papers is available in the papers/ directory.

🚀 Availability

  • Servers are available for installation and running from GitHub repositories.
  • A web-based directory is synced with the repository.

💡 Why it matters

  • Extends AI capabilities through various integrations.
  • Automatically fetches the latest research papers.
  • Provides a centralized directory for MCP servers.

📚 References

  • Checkout awesome-mcp-clients and glama.ai/mcp/clients.
  • Looking for a hosted server? See awesome-remote-mcp-servers.
  • Embodied-AI-Daily Web: http://luohongkun.top/Embodied-AI-Daily/
